http/client_policy#

What a client allows itself: limits, timeouts, protocols, connections and endpoints.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

HttpClient(
    limits: HttpLimits(header_bytes: 65536, line_bytes: 8192, body_bytes: 10485760),
    timeouts: ClientTimeouts(connection: Duration(seconds: 5), headers: Duration(seconds: 10), body_idle: Duration(seconds: 10)),
);

Description#

What a client allows itself: limits, timeouts, protocols, connections and endpoints.

By default: 64 KiB of header, 8 KiB per line, 1 GiB of body, 30 seconds for each timeout, HTTP/1.1, 8 connections and public endpoints only.
